title: UpdateAssistantConversationRequest
description: Request body of PATCH /api/assistant-conversations/:id (HEL-663) -- pin/unpin and/or rename. Both fields are plain optional (absent = unchanged); a rename is permanent and is never re-derived once set (design.md D6).

pinned.description: When present, sets the conversation's pinned state.

title.description: When present, permanently overrides the conversation's title (derived or default).
